command: bash dev/toy/test-guard-enforce.sh setup 2>&1 | grep -qF "PASS: setup refuses to commit an adoption file holding a private line (exit 1, nothing committed)"
description: Given an adoption whose staged file holds a private line, when setup runs, then it refuses before its own commit, naming the place, and commits nothing.

command: bash dev/toy/test-guard-enforce.sh push 2>&1 | grep -qF "PASS: an update of an existing branch with a planted line is refused by the pre-push hook, naming file and line"
description: Given the pre-push hook and a branch whose commit holds a private line, when it is pushed, then the hook refuses naming file and line, and nothing reaches the remote.

command: bash dev/toy/test-push-guard.sh refuse 2>&1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given a goal worker, when it pushes main, another branch, a tag, a deletion or a mixed push, then the pre-push hook refuses with WORKER_PUSH and nothing reaches origin.

command: bash dev/toy/test-push-guard.sh allow 2>&1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given a goal worker, when it pushes its own loop/<slug> branch (forced or up to date), then the push goes through.

command: bash dev/toy/test-push-guard.sh where 2>&1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given the operation checkout and a worktree, when where runs, then only the worktree is a worker, so the operation merge and release pushes are unaffected.

command: bash dev/toy/test-defect.sh size-139
description: Given criteria.py's page rules moved into deployments.py by a pure move, when health's size rule and the split checks run, then neither file warns and every moved name resolves the same on criteria.

command: bash dev/toy/test-defect.sh size-140
description: Given docs.py's page map moved into counting.py by a pure move, when health's size rule and the split checks run, then neither file warns and every moved name resolves the same on docs.

command: bash dev/toy/test-defect.sh size-141
description: Given regression.py's row and page readers moved into runs.py by a pure move, when health's size rule and the split checks run, then neither file warns and every moved name resolves the same on regression.

command: bash dev/toy/test-pods.sh docs 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given the Monitoring PRD, when MON-13, MON-14 and MON-15 are read, then each is Reviewed with a valid seal.

command: bash dev/toy/test-pods.sh owner 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given a goal owned by pod-a, when pod-b acts on it, then one REFUSED line names pod-a, nothing changes and the board marks it owned by pod-a.

command: bash dev/toy/test-pods.sh lock 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given two concurrent merges into one repo, when both run, then they serialize and a dead or old lock is replaced.

command: bash dev/toy/test-pods.sh layers twopods 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given two independent operation sessions, when both claim and work one repo, then neither is refused and neither collides.

command: bash dev/toy/test-pods.sh blocks 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given three repos, when the check-in prints, then each repo is a == name == block within 60 columns.

command: bash dev/toy/test-pods.sh size 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given the package, when sizes are counted, then no script reaches 20 KB, none newly crosses 18 KB, and the package has 99 files or fewer.

command: bash dev/toy/test-pods.sh layers 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given a second session's claim, when it claims, then the first stays an operation session and nothing refuses or warns.

command: bash dev/toy/test-pods.sh blocks 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given a cross-repo dependency, when the check-in prints, then it is listed between headed repo blocks.

command: bash dev/toy/test-pods.sh owner 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given another pod's goal, when a pod acts on it, then it is refused naming the owner and shown owned by that pod.

command: bash dev/toy/test-pods.sh lock 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given two pods merging into one main, when they run together, then the lock serializes them.

command: bash dev/toy/test-codex.sh home >/dev/null 2>&1
description: Given a Codex sandbox that leaves the home folder read-only, when setup adopts a clean toy repo, then it says the private settings were not written and still adopts the repo, with no crash.

command: bash dev/toy/test-codex.sh collide 2>&1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given a Codex pod and a Claude Code pod that know nothing of each other, when they queue goals, bind workers and run lanes in the same toy repos at once, then no goal or binding is lost, a repeated slug is refused, the lanes share one slot pool and take turns, and their private flow files stay apart.

command: bash dev/toy/test-codex.sh skip 2>&1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given a regression row that cannot run on this machine, when it exits 77, then the run records it as SKIPPED, never PASS, opens no issue, and a later lane runs it again.

command: bash dev/toy/test-codex.sh fake 2>&1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given a stand-in for codex that runs the prompt's commands, when the Codex harness runs them on a clean toy repo with no private settings, then setup adopts, go freezes the goal, the live board lists it, health check prints its verdict and regression run prints its result.

command: bash dev/toy/test-codex.sh live
description: Given a clean toy repo with no private settings and a Codex that is installed, signed in and able to answer, when Codex runs setup, go, the live board, health check and regression run, then each runs and leaves what it should; where Codex is not available the row exits 77 and is SKIPPED, never PASS.

command: bash dev/toy/test-lane-tmpdir.sh 2>&1 | grep -qF "PASS: the fixture that refuses a TMPDIR inside a git checkout passes under the lane"
description: Given a test that refuses to write inside a git checkout, when it runs under the lane, then it passes, because the lane's TMPDIR is outside any checkout (issue 814).

command: bash dev/toy/test-lane-tmpdir.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given lanes of different goals, when they run, then each has its own loop-lane folder under the system temp, gone when the lane ends, and a system temp inside a git checkout is refused with LANE_TMPDIR.

command: bash dev/toy/test-autorelease.sh 2>&1 | grep -c '^PASS: a [a-z]* report: ' | grep -qx 6
description: Given a goal state whose report is null, a string or has a non-string text, when the release fails and merge.py refuses, then it prints REFUSED with its fix on stderr, exits non-zero with no traceback, and records the failure on the goal.

command: bash dev/toy/test-delivery-release.sh wikinull 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qx "ALL PASS"
description: Given a goal state whose report is null or a string, when the wiki publish is refused, then it prints WIKI REFUSED with its fix, exits 1 with no traceback, and records the failure on the goal.
